Kalsooni xad-dhaaf ah ayay muujinaysaa.

choices.text: I'm not sure, I'll check and follow up.
choices.textSo: Ma hubo; waan hubin doonaa oo dib ayaan kuugu soo noqon doonaa.
choices.feedbackSo: Daacadnimo; waqti cayiman ku dar.

n2.saySo: Ka warran haddii suuqu hoos u dhaco?

n3.speaker: Audience member
n3.say: Thank you. That was very helpful.

choices.text: Thank you for your questions. Please feel free to email me.
choices.textSo: Waad ku mahadsan tihiin su’aalihiinna. Haddii aad wax kale qabtaan, iimayl iigu soo diri kartaan.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa gunaanad xirfad leh.
Aad bay u gaaban tahay oo qallafsan.

choices.feedback: Add an invitation to follow up.
choices.feedbackSo: Ku dar martiqaad ay kula soo xidhiidhi karaan.

n3.saySo: Mahadsanid. Taasi aad bay waxtar u lahayd.

contextSo: Waxaad dhamaysay bandhig ganacsi, dhagaystayaashuna su’aalo ayay ku weydiinayaan.

title: At the doctor's
context: You are visiting a doctor because you feel unwell.

n1.speaker: Doctor
n1.say: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

choices.text: I've had a sore throat and a headache since Monday.
choices.textSo: Isniintii ilaa hadda cunaha ayaa i xanuunaya, madaxana wuu i xanuunayaa.
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu sharxayaa calaamadaha iyo muddada.
Macne cad ma laha.
Calaamadaha ku dar.

choices.text: Yes, it was thirty-eight degrees this morning.
choices.textSo: Haa, saaka heerkulkaygu wuxuu ahaa siddeed iyo soddon darajo.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa jawaab faahfaahsan.

choices.feedback: Say "I am not sure; I did not check."
choices.feedbackSo: Dheh: “Ma hubo; ma aanan cabbirin.”
Haddii aad karto, faahfaahin bixi.

n3.speaker: Doctor
n3.say: I will give you a prescription. Take one tablet twice a day.

choices.text: Thank you. Should I take it with food?
choices.feedbackSo: Waa su’aal daba socota oo wanaagsan.
Haddii aanad hubin, weydii.
Dheh: “Waan ka xumahay, ma ku celin kartaa?”

n3.saySo: Waxaan kuu qorayaa warqad daawo. Qaado hal kiniin laba jeer maalintii.

end.speaker: Doctor
end.say: Rest well and drink plenty of water.
end.saySo: Si fiican u naso, biyo badanna cab.

contextSo: Waxaad booqanaysaa dhakhtar sababtoo ah caafimaad ma dareemaysid.
